lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white blobs are arranged in approximately nine visible vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank. Blobs posterior to the gills form a rectangular grid pattern with uniform inter-blob spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible; blobs are positioned centrally within these bands, creating anchor nodes at the intersection of vertical columns and horizontal alignment axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a dense distribution of high-luminance blobs; spots are smaller than those on the flank and are concentrated uniformly across the visible fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae individuals trailing beneath the ventral surface and near the pelvic fins.
